This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal www.axtroid.com/documentation.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

Before you start using DocStudio, user must download the stand-alone app.Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.

Make sure you see instructions page.

Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.

Click ⚙️Settings icon on the top left.

Fill the details as shown below then click Save Settings.Owner: axtroid

Repo: documentation

Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)

Branch: main

Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)The application must be restarted to load the latest content from the server.
